part.text:
All 20 tests pass. The implementation in `list-ops.js` stores items in a plain `values` array and builds every result with index-based loops and the array literal — no `Array.prototype` methods are used.

- `constructor(values = [])` — defaults to an empty list
- `append(list2)` — copies both lists' items into a new list
- `concat(list2)` — recursively flattens nested `List` items, appending non-list items directly
- `filter(predicate)`, `map(fn)` — iterate and collect into a new list
- `length()` — counts items with a loop
- `foldl(fn, acc)` / `foldr(fn, acc)` — reduce left-to-right and right-to-left, calling `fn(acc, item)`
- `reverse()` — copies items in reverse order without flattening
